meta.title: Multi-Currency Intake: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Sign in as users with and without the Requester / End User role on the specified Enterprise tenant.
Open and use Multi-Currency Intake to obtain multi-currency intake templates.
Compare the refusal or absence for the unqualified user with availability for the Requester / End User.
Verify or report the tenant's RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted access.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as users with and without the Requester / End User role on the specified Enterprise tenant.; Open and use Multi-Currency Intake to obtain multi-currency intake templates.; Compare the refusal or absence for the unqualified user with availability for the Requester / End User.; Verify or report the tenant's RBAC configuration when additional roles are deliberately granted access.

args.need: sign in as the user without the Requester / End User role and as a Requester / End User on the specified Enterprise tenant, attempt Multi-Currency Intake for each, and report whether intake templates are refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as arbitrary personas, reach Multi-Currency Intake, or compare role-based access.
Confirm the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's role-access checks.
